snippet.title: Dekaduck - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet Dekaduck, a bounty hunter that's half duck, half robot! Together with his creator Dr. Less and his daughter, Petite, they fly around in space searching for a quick way to get rich!

DekaDuck is a dynamic, retro-inspired 2D action platformer, featuring fully hand drawn art and animations. Fight enemies using their own abilities and quirks to solve puzzles and defeat bosses, in this sci-fi world full of conspiracies!

Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3715040/DekaDuck/
Soon on Kickstarter : https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/andreyin/dekaduck-fast-paced-2d-platformer
Our Socials :
